rate_limits: 10 simultaneously processing Marketing API requests per user; excess requests return 429. No per-customer increase is currently available.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor correct — official Marketing API docs state 10 simultaneous connections per user (not ~10 req/s), 429 on excess, and limit cannot be raised per customer (https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/fundamentals/#throttling). example.response_snippet: auditor correct — GET API Root returns account info + _links, not {} (https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/api/root/ and https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/api/root/get-account-info/). Free tier/auth/base_url not disputed.
